name: gyrmonitor
description: Foundation workspace for the GyrMonitor MVP.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend && node scripts/verify-foundation.mjs build
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend && node scripts/verify-foundation.mjs lint
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check --workspace backend && npm run format:check --workspace frontend && node scripts/verify-foundation.mjs format
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend && node scripts/verify-foundation.mjs test
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
